_about: What the Research pillar catalogues (S1-10). tools/research/build_catalogue.py reads this, fetches each entry's metadata and licence from the source itself, and writes registry/datasets.json. Add an entry here, never in datasets.json by hand. 'origin' says whether the data was measured or simulated; ML must know the difference.
